# AstryxTextArea { #anylumino.AstryxTextArea }

```python
AstryxTextArea(
    value='',
    *,
    label='',
    placeholder='',
    rows=3,
    disabled=False,
    **props,
)
```

Render a multiline Astryx text area.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Default   |
|-------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value       | str    | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `''`      |
| label       | str    | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `''`      |
| placeholder | str    | Placeholder text shown when the control is empty.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `''`      |
| rows        | int    | Rows or records rendered by the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `3`       |
| disabled    | bool   | Whether the component should render disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `False`   |
| **props     | Any    | JSON-safe TextArea props. Useful keys: isLabelHidden, description, isOptional, isRequired, isLoading, maxLength, status, labelTooltip, startIcon, hasSpellCheck, hasAutoFocus, size, htmlName, className, and style. anylumino manages label, value, placeholder, rows, disabled state, and change synchronization. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/TextArea>. | `{}`      |
